member.remarks: The applying candidate is taken from the bearer token, so there is no CandidateId field in the request body — this makes it impossible to apply on behalf of someone else.
member.param: The id of the job to apply for.
member.response: The application was created.

member.response: The application was cancelled.
The application is past the UnderReview state and can no longer be cancelled.

member.name: M:JobApplication.API.Controllers.JobsController.Close(System.Int32)
member.summary: Closes the job. Only its owner may close it.
member.remarks:
Sets the job to inactive and records ClosedAt and ClosedBy. The caller is identified by the bearer token and must be the recruiter who owns the job.
A job may only be closed once — closing it again returns 400.
member.param: The id of the job to close.
member.response: The job was closed.
The job is already closed.
The token is missing or invalid.
The caller is not a Recruiter, or does not own the job.
No job with the supplied id exists.
